Name: Pink Prismatic Tools
Author: bozeupasi
Description:
[size=4][b]Description[/b][/size]
[size=3]Retexture for Prismatic Tools Continued. Changes the appearance
of all prismatic tools to a rose pink and iridium style.[/size]

[size=4][b]Installation instructions[/b][/size]
[size=3]1. Download the archive
2. Open the folder PrismaticTools in your Mods folder
3. Go to assets/
4. Replace tools.png and prismatic_tools.png with the files from this mod[/size]

[size=4][b]Main features[/b][/size]
[size=3]- New rose pink and iridium color palette for all prismatic tools
- Covers all tools: axe, pickaxe, hoe, watering can[/size]

[size=4][b]Requirements[/b][/size]
[size=3]Prismatic Tools Continued by iargue — [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/21450]Nexus link[/url][/size]
